column4: Classic hanging foliage with gracefully arching feathery fronds. Thrives in humid bathrooms or shaded patios.
Fragrant woody perennial herb with needle-like foliage and petite lavender-blue flowers. Kitchen-ready culinary staple.
Hardy, air-purifying architectural plant with stiff, upright yellow-bordered sword leaves. Extremely low maintenance.
Compact, drought-tolerant succulent with dark green rosettes marked by distinctive raised white ridges.
Trained 5-year-old miniature tree with an S-curved trunk, dense oval canopy, and striking exposed surface roots.
Native pollinator magnet with prominent spiny cones and vibrant magenta ray florets. Blooms all summer.
Self-pollinating patio citrus that yields fragrant blossoms alongside sweet, thin-skinned culinary lemons year-round.
Chunky, free-draining substrate blend of orchid bark, perlite, coconut coir, and worm castings for root aeration.
